feeds.title: Seattle Art Museum Blog
feeds.description: Seattle Art Museum is connecting Art to Life one blog post at a time. Learn more about our global collection, local community, and renowned exhibitions from anywhere in the world with the Seattle Art Museum Blog.

feeds.title: Iskra Fine Art Blog
feeds.description: My art practice is rooted in the traditions of contemplative art, influenced greatly by my years as a student of Asian calligraphy and my ongoing design career as a calligrapher and letterform artist. I use many different media, but in all of them I attend closely to the language of mark-making and the delicate interactions of surface with intention and its opposites.

feeds.title: Glass Art Society Blog
feeds.description: The Glass Art Society's blog provides useful resources like job postings and upcoming exhibitions on their blog. Founded in 1971 by Fritz Dreisbach, Mark Peiser, and William Bernstein, the Glass Art Society was formed out of a desire to bring together the glass community so people could work together and learn from each other.

feeds.title: Seattle Artist League
feeds.description: V. Notes tells us about the the work of various artists, students, and much more. The Seattle Artist League is an art school with professional artist-instructors teaching drawing, painting, pottery, printmaking, and more. Our small class sizes and studio workshops provide hands-on education accessible to anyone who endeavors to make art a daily part of their life.

feeds.title: West Seattle Art Walk
feeds.description: West Seattle Art Walk updates you on the latest Art Walk and music events happening in Seattle. The West Seattle art walk is a monthly art event that is held the second Thursday of each month 5pm to late year-round. The art walk is hosted by the local West Seattle merchants who feature a wide range of art and showcase our vibrant artist community.

feeds.title: Art Beat
feeds.description: Art Beat is Seattle's official arts and culture hub where you can know about artists and the art programs happening within Seattle. We activate and sustain Seattle through arts and culture.

feeds.title: Seattle Art Source
feeds.description: Seattle Art Source gives you the latest art news, events, behind the scenes, and more. Seattle Art Source was founded in 2017 to provide interior designers, architects and homeowners an approachable way to purchase original art.

feeds.title: Daily Art Habit Blog
feeds.description: Creative empowerment with an iPad and Adobe Photoshop Sketch. View the collections of original digital art pieces by Stephanie Krimmel. The Daily Art Habit started in May 2018 as a simple challenge to myself, born from a need to lean and grow out of a transitional period in my life. It's become empowering and transformational.

feeds.title: Seattle Magazine » Arts & Culture
feeds.description: Seattle's guide to the best shows, performances and other events. Seattle magazine is the 'owner's manual' for active, urban-minded people who live in the Seattle area and want to feel connected to their community. It keeps readers on the pulse of restaurants, personalities, arts, entertainment and culture that reflect the tapestry of our dynamic landscape.

feeds.title: West Seattle Blog » WS Culture/Arts
feeds.description: The West Seattle Blog is a place where you can find posts about news in arts, culture and a lot more. Visit the West Seattle Blog website to get 24/7 news, city updates and connect with the community.

feeds.title: Seattle Met » Arts & Culture
feeds.description: Your guide to the best arts, culture, and events in Seattle, Washington, featuring reviews, music, galleries, books, comedy, theater, dance, and more. Seattle Met illuminates a thriving city for newcomers and longtime residents, chronicling the present and our city's rich past. We cover arts, dining, fashion, travel, and the great outdoors.

feeds.title: CityArts Magazine
feeds.description: City Arts is a platform for arts and culture in the Seattle area. From 2006 to 2018, it produced a monthly print magazine as well as regular online content and a suite of events - all of which were designed to support the local creative ecosystem. By telling the stories of this place, City Arts helped the community to better know itself and share our culture with the world.

feeds.title: The Seattle Times » Visual Arts
feeds.description: Find out what is showing around the Seattle area and all the news from the world of visual arts. As the Northwest's comprehensive news source, The Seattle Times provides clarity above the clutter, delivering news that matters where, when and how readers want it.
